usedFor: Mailparser pulls structured data out of emails and Google Contacts stores people, so “New Email Parsed” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Parsed” in Mailparser, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: Each parsed lead or form email becomes a saved contact without retyping.

watchOut: “New Parsed Email (one request per row)” runs per row, so one email with many rows can create many contacts.
